content.text:
I made a set of bug fixes and accessibility tweaks to `0.html`, keeping the look and behaviour the same. Nothing was tested in a browser — shell commands other than the first directory listing were blocked in this session, so I only edited the file.

## Bugs fixed

- **Keyboard handling:** I removed the custom `keydown` handler. A `<button>` already fires `click` on Space and Enter, and the extra handler risked double-firing in some browsers and cycled colours rapidly when a key was held.
- **Storage errors:** `localStorage` reads and writes are now wrapped in `try/catch`, so the page still works when storage is blocked instead of the script dying on load.
- **Pulse on load:** the glow animation no longer plays on page load, only on an actual colour change. The colour is also no longer re-saved on load.
- **Pulse on rapid clicks:** the animation now restarts on each click. Before, clicking mid-animation did nothing, and each call added another `animationend` listener; there is now a single one.
- **Unreadable `<kbd>` in high contrast:** the key hint reused the shadow colour as its background, which became near-black behind dark text under `prefers-contrast: more`. It now has its own `--kbd-bg` variable, with a dark-mode value.

## Accessibility and layout

- **Reduced motion:** the pulse animation now only runs when the user has no reduced-motion preference.
- **High contrast and forced colours:** the hint text is fully opaque under `prefers-contrast: more`, and `<kbd>` has a transparent border that shows up in forced-colours mode.
- **Short viewports:** the circle is capped at `60vh`, so it should no longer push the text off-screen in landscape on a phone.
- **Older browsers:** added a `100vh` fallback ahead of `100dvh`.
- **Hint text:** it now mentions Enter as well as Space.

## Cleanup

- Removed the `svg circle { transition: r }` rule, which did nothing because the radius never changes.
- Removed the `color` transition on the `svg`, which was redundant with the one on the button.
